title: Vesein Tal Umatar Begins
body: Residents of chutz la’aretz start saying Vesein Tal Umatar tonight during Maariv, while those in Eretz Yisroel began on the 7th of Cheshvan.

title: Israeli Lawmaker Sparks Debate
body: Israeli MK Boaz Bismuth sparked controversy with comments on the giyus issue, saying people cannot be forced to enlist in the army, triggering a heated discussion.
